scope: Operational shared scoring lifecycle and full-freeze boundary; synthetic completion records and real CPU subprocesses. Not model inference, GPU utilization, or production numerical equivalence.
checks: Default training commands retain original budgets
Exclusive task ownership and child-inherited leases
Scoring requires all 100 frozen training records
Missing, partial, or changed freezes stop before launching children
Freeze changes stop the scoring worker
Children must produce phase-specific completion markers
Scoring failures and leases are separate from training
